eligibility: Deduplicate exact causal prefixes within domain/source split; eligible tokens must occur in training token table and have at least two distinct evaluation prefixes within that stratum. No token-frequency threshold or outcome selection.
control: For each eligible context compare its own frozen token-centered prediction versus uniform choice of all other same-token context predictions. Exact expectation using all off-diagonal pairs; each recipient weighted equally. Predictions and means unchanged, no new fitting.
theory: wrong-minus-paired SSE = 2*n/(n-1)*sum centered_prediction dot centered_target within each token. Token-constant biases cancel, so pairing advantage distinguishes contextual covariance from a token-constant correction.
scope: All six native half directions, three layers, task train/evaluation and natural evaluation strata separately. No cross-stratum donor mixing or new task-holdout exposure. Local geometry first; no native output intervention in this stage.
stopping: Audit exact expectation and prefix eligibility before causal escalation. No shuffle seed selection, new fits or threshold search.
